name: Plague Satchel
senses: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius); Passive Perception 14

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The satchel makes two Buckle attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Buckle Burst.

Actions.name: Buckle
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.

Actions.name: Buckle Burst
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded condition until the end of the satchel's next turn.

Bonus Actions.name: Umbral Step
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the satchel takes the Hide action.

Traits.name: Learned to Walk
Traits.text: The satchel can move on its own across the ground on its buckle-legs, walking and standing as a creature does rather than needing to be carried.

Traits.name: Spider Climb
Traits.text: The satchel can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
Traits.expressedQuote: The satchel can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

lore: A doctor's satchel left on a plague-cart during the last great sickness, it absorbed the dying breath of its owner and now walks the roads, hungry for the lungs of the living.

generation.userConcept: a plague-doctor's bag that has learned to walk
generation.cite: composition after Phase Spider (CR 3) — the rider-heavy bite and the phase-cycle bonus action, scaled into the band

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
monsterDescription: a plague-doctor's bag that has learned to walk
